findings.description: Draft exact build/receive inventories omit native-startup.json and qualified supervisor process JSON outputs, so unchanged native roles cannot satisfy them.
Draft seals job.json and source-provenance.json without comparing their contents with prepared expected bytes; altered settings or provenance can enter accepted closure.
Actual os.replace followed by controlled KeyboardInterrupt escapes without UNKNOWN while the accepted pointer is committed.

executionClaim: Four independent CPU controls in draft-controls.json confirm initial draft R1/R2/R3 findings.
